llm_response.reason: This website displays multiple strong scam indicators: missing About/Contact/Terms/Privacy pages; no business or owner info; only a cart link with no means of customer support or legal compliance; unverified use of the Mizuno brand name; lack of external reviews or legitimate presence; use of a generic site template. All of these match known fake shop scams intending to fraudulently collect payments and/or personal info without delivering goods.
